steps.caption: SEO Suite
steps.narration: This is the SEO Suite: where your site ranks, who links to it, and what to fix on it.

steps.caption: Every site you track
steps.narration: The dashboard sums up every site you track. This roofing company has three, with fifty-four tracked keywords.

steps.caption: Rank tracker
steps.narration: Rank tracker checks where the site ranks in Google, every week by default.

steps.caption: The open tool, at the top
steps.narration: The tool you're in shows at the top; the rest are on the left.

steps.caption: Visibility: estimated share of clicks
steps.narration: Visibility estimates the share of clicks the site wins from its positions: 23.1 percent.

steps.caption: Keywords in each band, at each check
steps.narration: The bars count the keywords in each band at every check, eleven in the top three now.

steps.caption: Local grid
steps.narration: Local grid shows where the business ranks in Google's local results across its area. A saved scan opens on its result.

steps.caption: A finished 7 × 7 scan
steps.narration: In this seven by seven scan, for roofing contractor denver, it's in the first three at sixteen of forty-nine points.

steps.caption: Your position at each point
steps.narration: Each circle is one point, with its position there.

steps.caption: Your row, marked You
steps.narration: Below, every business the scan found is counted. Yours is marked: sixteen points in the first three, against twenty-five for the leaders.

steps.caption: Site explorer
steps.narration: Site explorer looks up any domain, yours or a competitor's.

steps.caption: Authority, backlinks, referring domains
steps.narration: Here's the site's authority, its backlinks, and the domains that link to it.

steps.caption: Site audit
steps.narration: Site audit crawls the site and lists what's broken. The health score is the share of pages with no errors.

steps.caption: Issues by severity
steps.narration: This crawl found no errors, two warnings and three notices.

steps.caption: Action plan
steps.narration: The Action plan turns findings into tasks, each with a status, a due date and an owner.

steps.caption: Open, in progress, done
steps.narration: The tiles count what's to do, in progress, and done.

steps.caption: A task from Site audit
steps.narration: This one came from Site audit, and links straight back to the issue.

steps.caption: Back to ConstructHUB
steps.narration: Back on the home page, the SEO Suite is in the menu on the left.

steps.caption: Menu: SEO Suite
steps.narration: You'll find it under Tools, as SEO Suite.

youtube.title: SEO Suite in under two minutes | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A short tour of the SEO Suite in ConstructHUB: a dashboard of every site you track, the rank tracker with visibility and positions over time, a finished local grid scan and who shows up in it, the Site explorer, the site audit and the action plan.
